sources.title: yanguanyue/DFTA-baselines · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DFTA baseline checkpoints Full checkpoint and supporting model-configuration backup for comparison methods used in the DFTA experiments. Evaluation scores, metric tables, logs, training previews and raw datasets are excluded. This repository is for preserving experiment artifacts; it does not bundle the complete execution environment.

sources.title: GitHub - yanguanyue/DFTA-
sources.snippet: Compared to baseline methods, DFTA maintains better morphological consistency, generates more coherent pathological textures, and achieves a superior balance between local details and global anatomy. Figure: Qualitative comparison across methods and lesion categories. Methods marked with (M) use lesion masks as input.
